Hi Jennifer,

If you didn't standardize HWY, doing so could help. Also, if your species is very rare, you could use output="kmsq". Another idea is to fit a model without covariates and then use those estimates as starting values for more complex models.

Richard

Subject: [unmarked] Making models converge with the Nelder-Mead method
Sent by: unma...@googlegroups.com




Hi--
 
I am using the "distsamp" function to estimate density in my sampling frame and model spatial covariates of interest.  I have 38 total models and for 19 of them, I needed to use the Nelder-Mead method to get starting values for the parameters in order for the models to converge (I used theCG method for 1 of the models in which the Nelder-Mead method didn't work).  I have an example below for 1 of my models (highway density).  I am wondering if I should be concerned about this, mainly that it could be indicating a problem with my data because I needed to provide starting values for over half of the models?  Thanks for any help!
 
hn_hwy = distsamp(~1 ~HWY, umf, keyfun="halfnorm", output="density",method="Nelder-Mead")
hn_hwy
hn_hwy = distsamp(~1 ~HWY, umf, keyfun="halfnorm",output="density", starts=c(-8.97,-2.09,9.07))
 
Jennifer
